bookmarks.description: List of regular bookmarks (key → directory mappings). Each entry maps a mark name to an absolute directory path. Duplicates are allowed and resolved at lookup time via -favour policy. Format: mark → destination path. (Not a nested object; flattened via items schema below).

bookmarks.items.destination.description: Absolute path to the directory being bookmarked.

portals.description: List of portal bookmarks (directories expanded into multiple subdirectory bookmarks). Format: mark → portal root path.

portals.items.mark.description: Portal name (key) that triggers expansion into subdirectories.

portals.items.destination.description: Absolute path to the portal root directory.

portal_expansions.description: List of bookmarks expanded from portals (subdirectories of portal roots). Format: mark → subdirectory path.

portal_expansions.items.mark.description: Bookmark name, typically the trailing component of the subdirectory.

portal_expansions.items.destination.description: Absolute path to the subdirectory of a portal.

config_metadata.generated_by.description: Identifier for the generator of this config (e.g., deployment tool name).
